name: Registry Observability
description: Dashboards, alerts, and metrics for schema usage, validation failures, deprecation timelines, and type generation health.
purpose: The registry is an operational system, not just documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows: schema versions in use, validation pass/fail rates, deprecation timeline
Alerts configured for: validation failure spike, type generation failure, stale schema versions
Metrics emitted per operation: validate, publish, deprecate, tombstone, generate types
Deprecation timeline view shows upcoming and overdue sunset dates
Type generation health metric tracks time since last successful generation
Dashboards accessible via internal monitoring system
Observability setup documented with runbooks for common alerts
